source: Local Create 6.0.10 jar inspected with javap; NeoForge capability implementation inspected in this project.
finding: Create FunnelBlockEntity.onTransfer(ItemStack) is invoked before the final insert in at least one handleDirectBeltInput path. It cannot unconditionally prove a successful accepted transfer. Other paths call it after extraction but before subsequent delivery.
belt_research: Create 6.0.10 ItemHandlerBeltSegment has insertItem and extractItem results plus a simulation flag. Its insertion code can mutate the supplied ItemStack, so a correct adapter must capture the offered stack before the call and compare with the actual returned remainder. No interception or game validation was added.
limitations: No item or fluid transfer meter is implemented or live-tested.
No FE transfer accounting is implemented.
Existing inventory differences remain net changes and are not production, consumption or throughput.
SU and FE remain separate; no conversion or energy integral is claimed.
next: Identify explicit metering boundaries and intercept actual return values, including simulate=false, partial transfer, failure, direction and deduplication; then test with real controlled item and fluid movement.
